name: gclbck-crealore-mods
description: Claude Code mods by Crealore. Add this marketplace once and install any of them.

plugins.name: is-it-done-yet
plugins.description: A progress pane beside the Claude Code terminal for big, multi-phase work. Open it in any existing project and it reads the project's plan file (PLAN.md, ROADMAP.md, TODO.md, docs/superpowers/plans, checkbox lists or status tables) or the agent's task list, then shows overall percent, an accordion of phases and tasks with green/blue/grey bars, elapsed time, a rough ETA, total tokens and the API-equivalent cost. Adds nothing to the model's context. Reach L1: reads plan files inside the project folder and the transcript's task calls; no processes, environment variables or network.

plugins.name: session-handoff-button
plugins.description: A Session Hand-off button above the prompt, green/orange/red by context usage (45% and 65% thresholds). While green it reads Context clean and cannot be pressed; from orange on, one press runs your handoff skill (or a built-in prompt), copies the handoff, runs /clear and sends it to the fresh session. Reach L2: drives Claude (one handoff turn, /clear, one prompt); no processes, files or network.
